s0501.literal: On gengxu day, because troops were impoverished, privy council director Temür Buqa was dispatched to rectify matters; an edict was also proclaimed throughout the realm that anyone who dared to harass or harm them would be punished.
s0501.idiomatic: On gengxu day, because troops were impoverished, privy council director Temür Buqa was dispatched to rectify matters; an edict was also proclaimed throughout the realm that anyone who dared to harass or harm them would be punished.

s0502.literal: Grain and notes were granted in relief to the orphaned and elderly in the northern region.
s0502.idiomatic: Grain and notes were granted in relief to the orphaned and elderly in the northern region.

s0503.literal: Princess Söge Bala was granted five hundred thousand ingots of notes.
s0503.idiomatic: Princess Söge Bala was granted 500,000 ingots of notes.

s0504.literal: The Urus, Qanqanas, and other tribes were impoverished; two brood mares were granted to each household.
s0504.idiomatic: The Urus, Qanqanas, and other tribes were impoverished; two brood mares were granted to each household.

s0505.literal: On renzi day Mars transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0505.idiomatic: On renzi day Mars transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0506.literal: On yimao day central secretariat grand councillor Temür Toq was dismissed and made Shangdu resident.
s0506.idiomatic: On yimao day central secretariat grand councillor Temür Toq was dismissed and made Shangdu resident.

s0507.literal: On renxu day Huai'an Route's Yancheng and Shanyang counties suffered flooding; their rent was remitted.
s0507.idiomatic: On renxu day Huai'an Route's Yancheng and Shanyang counties suffered flooding; their rent was remitted.

s0508.literal: The imperial carriage halted at Xinghe; attendants on left and right, because the cold was severe, requested returning to the capital; the Emperor said, "For troops, cattle and horses are paramount; for the people, crops and harvests are fundamental.
s0508.idiomatic: The imperial carriage halted at Xinghe; attendants on left and right, because the cold was severe, requested returning to the capital; the Emperor said, "For troops, cattle and horses are paramount; for the people, crops and harvests are fundamental.

s0509.literal: We have delayed specifically so horses may graze on fodder and the people may reap their harvest — one stroke, two gains; why consider the cold?
s0509.idiomatic: We have delayed specifically so horses may graze on fodder and the people may reap their harvest — one stroke, two gains; why consider the cold?

s0510.literal: " Leizhou Route's Haikang and Suixi counties suffered seawater overflow, damaging more than four thousand qing of people's fields; their rent was remitted.
s0510.idiomatic: Leizhou Route's Haikang and Suixi counties suffered seawater overflow, damaging more than 4,000 qing of people's fields; their rent was remitted.

s0511.literal: In Qinzhou's Chengji County there was a mountain collapse.
s0511.idiomatic: In Qinzhou's Chengji County there was a mountain collapse.

s0512.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day Mars transgressed Lingtai.
s0512.idiomatic: Ninth month, on yihai day Mars transgressed Lingtai.

s0513.literal: The capital suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of grain were released and sold at reduced price.
s0513.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; 100,000 shi of grain were released and sold at reduced price.

s0514.literal: On bingzi day the halt was at Angwu Ridge.
s0514.idiomatic: On bingzi day the halt was at Angwu Ridge.

s0515.literal: On renwu day Mars transgressed the Upper General of the Western Rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0515.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars transgressed the Upper General of the Western Rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0516.literal: Prince Sarmagan was granted fifty thousand ingots of notes.
s0516.idiomatic: Prince Sarmagan was granted 50,000 ingots of notes.

s0517.literal: On renchen day central secretariat grand councillor Tash Haiya was caned and dismissed on grounds of accepting bribes.
s0517.idiomatic: On renchen day central secretariat grand councillor Tash Haiya was caned and dismissed on grounds of accepting bribes.

s0518.literal: On dingyou day Mars transgressed the Right Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0518.idiomatic: On dingyou day Mars transgressed the Right Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0519.literal: The imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0519.idiomatic: The imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0520.literal: On gengzi day Anlu Prefecture's Han River overflowed, damaging people's fields; relief was granted.
s0520.idiomatic: On gengzi day Anlu Prefecture's Han River overflowed, damaging people's fields; relief was granted.

s0521.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinchou new moon, Buddhist rites were performed within the palace.
s0521.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on xinchou new moon, Buddhist rites were performed within the palace.

s0522.literal: The sorcerer-monk Yuanming and others were executed.
s0522.idiomatic: The sorcerer-monk Yuanming and others were executed.

s0523.literal: On jiachen day Venus crossed the meridian.
s0523.idiomatic: On jiachen day Venus crossed the meridian.

s0524.literal: On wushen day Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0524.idiomatic: On wushen day Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0525.literal: On gengxu day the Emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0525.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0526.literal: On renzi day Baizhu presented auspicious grain with two stalks bearing a single ear.
s0526.idiomatic: On renzi day Baizhu presented auspicious grain with two stalks bearing a single ear.

s0527.literal: On guichou day an edict directed that Hanlin and Imperial Archives officials aged seventy were not to retire.
s0527.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict directed that Hanlin and Imperial Archives officials aged seventy were not to retire.

s0528.literal: Because of flooding in the interior commanderies, non-urgent corvée projects were halted.
s0528.idiomatic: Because of flooding in the interior commanderies, non-urgent corvée projects were halted.

s0529.literal: An edict directed that Mongol children sold as slaves to Hui and Han people were to be taken in and raised by the state.
s0529.idiomatic: An edict directed that Mongol children sold as slaves to Hui and Han people were to be taken in and raised by the state.

s0530.literal: Central secretariat clerical staff were forbidden from leaking state secrets; the privy council was ordered to dispatch officials to inspect troops and horses in each commandery.
s0530.idiomatic: Central secretariat clerical staff were forbidden from leaking state secrets; the privy council was ordered to dispatch officials to inspect troops and horses in each commandery.

s0531.literal: On wuwu day the Prince of Zhao Maqali Division Revenue and Grain Intendant Office was established, rank 3a.
s0531.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Prince of Zhao Maqali Division Revenue and Grain Intendant Office was established, rank 3a.

s0532.literal: On jiwei day Zhaoqing Route suffered flooding; relief was granted.
s0532.idiomatic: On jiwei day Zhaoqing Route suffered flooding; relief was granted.

s0533.literal: On bingyin day Henan branch secretariat associate administrator Nijamadin was dismissed from office on grounds of cruelty.
s0533.idiomatic: On bingyin day Henan branch secretariat associate administrator Nijamadin was dismissed from office on grounds of cruelty.

s0534.literal: On dingmao day six posts of interpreter attendants and four posts of ceremonial attendants were added to the Ceremonial Office.
s0534.idiomatic: On dingmao day six posts of interpreter attendants and four posts of ceremonial attendants were added to the Ceremonial Office.

s0535.literal: On jisi day El Temür was dispatched to patrol the frontier.
s0535.idiomatic: On jisi day El Temür was dispatched to patrol the frontier.

s0536.literal: Eleventh month, on xinwei day Mars transgressed Jinxian.
s0536.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on xinwei day Mars transgressed Jinxian.

s0537.literal: On jihai day the Emperor visited the Great State-Protecting Benevolent King Temple.
s0537.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor visited the Great State-Protecting Benevolent King Temple.

s0538.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Void Bridge.
s0538.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Void Bridge.

s0539.literal: On wuyin day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall; assembled officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Continuing Heaven, Embodying the Way, Reverent in Culture, Benevolent and Martial, Greatly Manifest and Filial.
s0539.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall; assembled officials presented the honorific title Emperor of Continuing Heaven, Embodying the Way, Reverent in Culture, Benevolent and Martial, Greatly Manifest and Filial.

s0541.literal: On jimao day, because the honorific title had been received, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; Baizhu requested releasing prisoners — it was not granted.
s0541.idiomatic: On jimao day, because the honorific title had been received, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; Baizhu requested releasing prisoners — it was not granted.

s0542.literal: On gengchen day three thousand corvée soldiers were added for Shou'an Mountain Temple.
s0542.idiomatic: On gengchen day 3,000 corvée soldiers were added for Shou'an Mountain Temple.

s0543.literal: On xinsi day Censor-in-chief Teshi was ordered to command the left and right Asud guards.
s0543.idiomatic: On xinsi day censor-in-chief Teshi was ordered to command the left and right Asud guards.

s0544.literal: On bingxu day the moon transgressed Well.
s0544.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon transgressed Well.

s0545.literal: On dinghai day instructor officials awaiting selection were temporarily registered as Guanghai patrol inspectors.
s0545.idiomatic: On dinghai day instructor officials awaiting selection were temporarily registered as Guanghai patrol inspectors.

s0546.literal: On jichou day the moon transgressed Wine Banner, and also transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0546.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon transgressed Wine Banner, and also transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0547.literal: On gengyin day Baizhu and others said, "Having received the honorific title, one ought to give thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, performing one libation offering.
s0547.idiomatic: On gengyin day Baizhu and others said, "Having received the honorific title, one ought to give thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, performing one libation offering.

s0548.literal: Shizu also once discussed carrying it out; Wuzong personally performed the thanksgiving rite.
s0548.idiomatic: Shizu also once discussed carrying it out; Wuzong personally performed the thanksgiving rite.

s0549.literal: " An edict stated, "We shall personally give thanks.
s0549.idiomatic: An edict stated, "We shall personally give thanks.

s0550.literal: " The Imperial Astronomer was ordered to divine the date; the privy council selected troops to drill the guard of honor.
s0550.idiomatic: The Imperial Astronomer was ordered to divine the date; the privy council selected troops to drill the guard of honor.

s0551.literal: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Mingtang.
s0551.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Mingtang.

s0552.literal: On guisi day because the garrison-farm intendant office's collection of liquor tax disturbed the people, the relevant offices were ordered to take over and monopolize it.
s0552.idiomatic: On guisi day because the garrison-farm intendant office's collection of liquor tax disturbed the people, the relevant offices were ordered to take over and monopolize it.

s0553.literal: On jiawu day mountain preserves within Liaoyang branch secretariat jurisdiction were placed under the Central Bureau for Imperial Household Affairs.
s0553.idiomatic: On jiawu day mountain preserves within Liaoyang branch secretariat jurisdiction were placed under the Central Bureau for Imperial Household Affairs.

s0554.literal: On bingshen day an edict directed that a stele for the late grand councillor Antong be erected at Baoding New City.
s0554.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict directed that a stele for the late grand councillor Antong be erected at Baoding New City.

s0555.literal: On wuxu day Gongchang's Chengzhou suffered famine; benevolent granaries were opened for relief.
s0555.idiomatic: On wuxu day Gongchang's Chengzhou suffered famine; benevolent granaries were opened for relief.

s0556.literal: On jihai day Venus transgressed Western Kui.
s0556.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus transgressed Western Kui.

s0557.literal: Twelfth month, on gengzi day winter clothing was granted to Mongol children.
s0557.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on gengzi day winter clothing was granted to Mongol children.

s0558.literal: On xinchou day Yiqi Lie was installed as empress; acting Grand Mentor and right central secretariat chancellor Temür Temür was dispatched with credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.
s0558.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yiqi Lie was installed as empress; acting grand mentor and right central secretariat chancellor Temür Temür was dispatched with credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.

s0559.literal: On guimao day, because the empress had been installed, an edict was proclaimed to the realm.
s0559.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the empress had been installed, an edict was proclaimed to the realm.

s0560.literal: Qingyuan Route suffered famine and Zhending Route suffered plague; both were granted relief.
s0560.idiomatic: Qingyuan Route suffered famine and Zhending Route suffered plague; both were granted relief.

s0561.literal: On jiachen day Mars transgressed Neck.
s0561.idiomatic: On jiachen day Mars transgressed Neck.

s0562.literal: On wushen day the Emperor personally gave thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0562.idiomatic: On wushen day the Emperor personally gave thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0563.literal: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0563.idiomatic: On gengxu day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0564.literal: The main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was constructed.
s0564.idiomatic: The main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was constructed.

s0565.literal: On jiayin day Yuquan River was dredged.
s0565.idiomatic: On jiayin day Yuquan River was dredged.

s0566.literal: The imperial carriage visited the Western monk's Abhiseka Temple.
s0566.idiomatic: The imperial carriage visited the Western monk's Abhiseka Temple.

s0567.literal: On jiwei day Sonam Zangbu was enfeoffed as Prince of Bailan and granted a gold seal.
s0567.idiomatic: On jiwei day Sonam Zangbu was enfeoffed as Prince of Bailan and granted a gold seal.

s0568.literal: Zhending, Baoding, Daming, Shunde, and other routes suffered flooding; the people suffered famine; brewing liquor was forbidden.
s0568.idiomatic: Zhending, Baoding, Daming, Shunde, and other routes suffered flooding; the people suffered famine; brewing liquor was forbidden.

s0569.literal: Gold tiger tallys were issued to branch secretariat grand councillors of each province.
s0569.idiomatic: Gold tiger tallys were issued to branch secretariat grand councillors of each province.

s0570.literal: On xinyou day Mars entered Di.
s0570.idiomatic: On xinyou day Mars entered Di.

s0571.literal: On jiazi day the Field Revenue Intendant Office was established, administering land tax of Ji and Jing prefectures to supply impoverished guard soldiers, rank 5b.
s0571.idiomatic: On jiazi day the field revenue intendant office was established, administering land tax of Ji and Jing prefectures to supply impoverished guard soldiers, rank 5b.

s0572.literal: The Imperial Preceptor Gagla Ras Gyinchen Bzangpo was ordered to proceed to the western regions to receive full ordination; he was granted one thousand three hundred fifty liang of gold, four thousand fifty liang of silver, ten thousand bolts of silks and cloths, and five hundred thousand ingots of notes.
s0572.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor Gagla Ras Gyinchen Bzangpo was ordered to proceed to the western regions to receive full ordination; he was granted 1,350 liang of gold, 4,050 liang of silver, 10,000 bolts of silks and cloths, and 500,000 ingots of notes.

s0573.literal: Because Prince Kebek's envoys repeatedly came to court, troops were deployed to guard Beikou and Lugou Bridge.
s0573.idiomatic: Because Prince Kebek's envoys repeatedly came to court, troops were deployed to guard Beikou and Lugou Bridge.

s0574.literal: Hejian Route suffered famine; relief was granted.
s0574.idiomatic: Hejian Route suffered famine; relief was granted.

s0575.literal: Ma Jianu was again made Situ.
s0575.idiomatic: Ma Jianu was again made Situ.

s0576.literal: On yichou day the Central Auspice Office was established.
s0576.idiomatic: On yichou day the Central Auspice Office was established.

s0577.literal: Five hundred thousand jin of copper was smelted to make Buddha images for Shou'an Mountain Temple.
s0577.idiomatic: 500,000 jin of copper was smelted to make Buddha images for Shou'an Mountain Temple.

s0578.literal: Ninghai Prefecture suffered locusts; Guide, Liaoyang, Tongzhou, and other places suffered flooding.
s0578.idiomatic: Ninghai Prefecture suffered locusts; Guide, Liaoyang, Tongzhou, and other places suffered flooding.
